raw_text: Build an internal employee directory where HR admins can add, edit, search, and deactivate staff profiles with department and role fields.
IT team needs a web app to track laptops and monitors, assign devices to employees, and log return dates.
Bakery staff need to create recipes, list ingredient quantities, calculate batch yields, and archive seasonal items.
Receptionists register new patients, update contact info, and attach insurance card notes.
Online store needs a shopping cart supporting percentage discount codes, stock reservation for 10 minutes, and order summary.
Wholesale buyers log in to view tiered bulk pricing, reorder past invoices in one click, and track shipment status.
Customers submit return requests within 14 days, select reason codes, and download prepaid return labels.
Marketplace sellers upload product listings, set inventory counts, and view payout balances.
Clients choose a service, pick an available stylist, and book a 30-minute time slot with email confirmation.
Members reserve hot desks by date and floor zone, check in via QR code, and cancel up to 2 hours prior.
Camera rental shop tracks daily availability, security deposits, and late return penalties.
Account executives move deals across stages (Lead, Demo, Proposal, Won/Lost), log call notes, and filter by expected close date.
Support agents categorize tickets by urgency, merge duplicate tickets, and view countdown timers for first-response SLA.
University advancement officers track donor pledges, campaign tags, and thank-you call reminders.
Marketing managers view daily impressions, click-through rate, conversion funnel charts, and export CSV reports.
Facility managers monitor hourly kWh usage per zone, set spike thresholds, and view monthly comparison graphs.
Site inspectors fill safety checklists offline on mobile, attach timestamped photos, and sync when back online.
Mobile users log daily water intake, configure custom reminder intervals, and view 7-day streak badges.
Receive incoming order webhooks, verify HMAC signatures, retry failed deliveries with exponential backoff, and log payloads.
Expose a paginated REST endpoint returning approved invoices by date range with idempotency keys.
Build an app like Airbnb for local photographers. Needs to launch soon.
Users pay utility bills online and get a receipt. Payment provider and fee rules are TBD.
Management wants a real-time KPI dashboard with role-based permissions, but KPIs and roles haven't been defined yet.
Calculate monthly employee bonuses and tax deductions automatically. Country tax brackets will be shared later.
Notify customers when their package is delayed. Notification channels and delay thresholds are undecided.
Customers must be able to complete checkout completely anonymously without creating an account or entering an email, and they must also log into their persistent loyalty profile before paying.

raw_text: All financial audit logs must be strictly immutable and never modified or deleted, while managers need a button to edit and delete erroneous audit log entries.
